correctness.rationale: Theorem A verified case-by-case: for U={(0,0),(1,0)}, V={(2,0),(3,0)} every candidate witness x=(k,w) fails by a fiber transposition fixing x and identifying a U-point with a V-point (k outside {0,1,2,3}: swap 0-2; k=0: swap 1-2; k=1: swap 0-2; k=2: swap 0-3; k=3: swap 0-2). Invariance E(a,b)=E(sigma.a,sigma.b) yields the contradiction true-vs-false in each case; only S4 on four fibers is used and |F|>=4 is exactly the 2-2 threshold. Theorem B fresh-orbit finite-extension construction verified: fresh K larger than all prior and requirement indices plus large t gives free pair-dependent variables M[K,i,t-m] with no diagonal or prior-conflict, symmetric counterparts defined consistently; union over enumerated requirements satisfies Rado extension and joint-shift invariance by construction. Both Python artifacts were re-executed and pass (0/1024 uniform impossibility; per-pair satisfiable). The only gap is the implicit enlargement of K_s to dominate the current requirement, a standard closable detail that does not affect validity.

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING route: finding arose directly from the blocked symmetric-centralizer E0-coding strategy for the commuting-pair conjugacy target, not a replacement. Two consolidated literature searches plus full fetch of Cameron Random Graph survey (arXiv:1301.7544), Bodirsky-Pinsker reducts (arXiv:0903.2553), and Grech-Kisielewicz wreath-product work found no prior statement of the F x Z fiber-permutation obstruction with the 2-2 witness. Equivalent imprimitive/wreath encodings, Thomas 5-reduct closed-supergroup classification, and standard Rado tables were tested and do not imply the claim: reducts classify supergroups of Aut(Rado), not fiber subgroups; wreath papers characterize Aut(G)=A wr B, not Rado non-existence. Prior universal-set Cayley work implies the Theorem B existence half (Z-shift-invariant Rado graphs are textbook) but not the obstruction; the paired contrast isolating fiber symmetry as the culprit is new. No database entry or broader census covers the exact |F|>=4 product parameter.

value.rationale: Paired obstruction-plus-contrast is independently retrievable: it constrains which group actions coexist with the Rado extension property, refutes in product form the most symmetric coding route toward non-smoothness of commuting-pair conjugacy (S_infty-symmetric Rado presentations), and redirects future work toward pair-dependent presentations. Object and invariant were motivated before computation by the target investigation; the exact non-existence value was not known or mechanically implied and a future researcher attacking symmetric Rado realizations could reasonably need it. Elementariness does not defeat value under the shared STANDARD narrow-datum clause. Limits are stated honestly (target smoothness dichotomy remains open). This is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration.
